paite: TOUPA phat un! Ka hinna aw, TOUPA phat in.
heading: Pathian, Hondampa Phatna
english: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh, my soul.

paite: Ka damsung teng in TOUPA ka phat ding a; ka hin lai teng in ka Pathian phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: While I live, I will praise Yahweh. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.

paite: Miliante gingta kei unla, mihing tapa panpihna himhim omlouhna gingta sam kei un.
english: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.

paite: Anakna in apawtsana, amah lei ah akik nawn a; huai ni mah in angaihtuahnate amang pah ahi.
english: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.

paite: Amah panpihtu dia Jakob' Pathian neimi in nuam asa hi, alametna TOUPA a Pathian ah a-om hi.
english: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God,

paite: Ama'n van leh lei abawl a, tuipi leh asung a om tengteng, ama'n thudik avom gige hi.
english: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;

paite: Nuaisiah a omte a ding in vai ahawmsak a, gilkialte kiang ah an apia a, TOUPA'N hentate asuaktasak hi;
english: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. Yahweh frees the prisoners.

paite: TOUPA'N mittawte mit ahihvaksak a; kun kheukheute TOUPA'N akaitang a; TOUPA'N midiktatte a-it hi;
english: Yahweh opens the eyes of the blind. Yahweh raises up those who are bowed down. Yahweh loves the righteous.

paite: TOUPA'N mikhualte aveng a; pabeite leh meithaite akhotuah a; himahleh gilou lampite alumlehsak hi.
english: Yahweh preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.

paite: TOUPA'N tangtawn in vai ahawm ding; Zion aw, na Pathian in suan tengteng tan in vai ahawm ding hi. TOUPA phat un!
english: Yahweh will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise Yah!
